# Stella Maynard

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** rose-red girl  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Stella is a vivid, black-eyed girl. She carried off the palm for beauty in the Second Year classes at Queen's Academy.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## Personality

She has a heart full of wistful, rainbow-like dreams and fancies. Anne Shirley describes her as the dearest girl in the world except for Diana Barry.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c36 P21](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0021)_

## Traits

- Thoughtful  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- Imaginative  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- Ambitious  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

## History

Stella attended Queen's Academy, where she formed a close circle of friends with other thoughtful and ambitious students like Anne Shirley and Priscilla Grant. During her second year, she was widely recognized for her beauty.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## Relationships

### Anne Shirley

- Friend of — Close friend and intimate at Queen's Academy  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c36 P21](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0021)</sub>

### Priscilla Grant

- Friend of — Close friend at Queen's Academy  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
